title: Repair rule/action/condition fidelity and discovery relationships
description:
Repair known rule/action/condition findings, including Search/Help structure, condition
lifecycle relationships, exhaustion/rest interactions, and source/discovery metadata.
Rules may remain source prose interpreted by the DM. Add structured representation where
it serves source fidelity, discovery, state integrity, or a positive deterministic capability.
design:
Depends on the A4 in-band readiness schema for rules. Reconcile the rule
disposition work against the existing 2026-07-06 artifacts before re-deriving:
docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-rule-classification.md and
2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-1-rule-disposition-layer-design.md. Those artifacts
predate the closure of eshyra-o9bd.18.7.8 and eshyra-2n1t; their conclusions must
be re-verified against the current pack, not assumed.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known Search/Help/condition/exhaustion findings are source-faithfully represented or explicitly dispositioned.
- Existing correct condition projections are preserved.
- Runtime discovery can surface governing/related rule material and known exceptions.
- Selected deterministic rule/action/condition operations have sufficient inputs and correct execution/state effects.
- Prose/model adjudication remains a valid default; absence of structured mechanics is never proof of no mechanic.
